notice: Structured summary for app display; not a word-for-word reproduction of the website.
introduction: The Holidays Club describes a no-refund policy for purchased vacation packages and services. Customers should review the official policy and contact the company before completing a purchase.

sections.title: 1. No-Refund Policy
content: The website states that once a vacation package or service has been purchased and consent has been provided, a refund will not be initiated.
The policy applies to payments for packages, processing fees, and other associated charges.
Purchases made through the platform are described as final.

sections.title: 2. Non-Transferable Packages
content: The website states that vacation packages are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for another product or service after purchase.
Package benefits are intended for the individual or individuals named in the agreement and may not be assigned or transferred to others.

sections.title: 3. Booking Changes and Upgrades
content: Requests to change booking dates, upgrade a vacation package, or modify related services are handled at the company's discretion.
Additional charges may apply. Approval of a change does not guarantee a refund or reimbursement.

sections.title: 4. Emergencies and Exceptional Circumstances
content: Customers facing an unforeseen emergency or exceptional circumstance may contact the Grievance Team for assistance.
The policy says refunds will not be provided, but the team may review the case and offer an alternative solution, such as rescheduling or postponing the vacation.

sections.title: 5. Grievance Team Contact
content: Office hours: Monday to Friday, 10:30 AM–5:30 PM IST.

sections.title: 6. Before Making a Purchase
content: Customers are advised to review the applicable terms and conditions before purchasing a vacation package.
For clarification, contact the company's support team before completing the transaction.
